title: gastrochilus patinatus
intro: Gastrochilus patinatus, commonly known as the Himalayan orchid, is a species of orchid found in the Himalayan region. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Gastrochilus patinatus include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and treat various gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
